description: Erection of single storey outbuilding in rear garden with pitched roof.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2020(AR)70-03, 2020(AR)70-01; received 12/11/2020
2020(AR)70-01 Rev A; received 15/02/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the outbuilding hereby approved.
Condition : 5 - Any guttering fitted to the outbuilding hereby approved shall not project outside the boundary of the site.

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the house and for no other purpose.   The outbuilding shall not be used as a self-contained dwelling, or be converted to include a bedroom, kitchen, living room or other primary residential accommodation, or be converted for use as an office for business purposes.
